title: Karen
creator: CrossFit
description: 150 wall-ball shots for time with a 20/14 lb ball to a 10/9 ft target, every shot from a full squat. Introduced in 2004; simple, elegant and unrelenting on the legs and lungs. Scale with a lighter ball or 75 reps.
